events.summary: D'Haren stares at the twisted metal that had been a prized artifact as the fight turns ugly.
events.quote: D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact.

events.summary: Theodar strides the battle lines snatching swords bare-handed until all cower before him.
events.quote: Theodar strode the battle lines, snatching swords with his bare hands and casting them aside until all cowered before him.

events.summary: The Archangel Anthius speaks to the Keepers of the Faith of the Sword of Faith.
events.quote: And then the Archangel Anthius spoke to them, saying, "Fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith."

events.summary: Nethya stiffens, head cocked, and falls lifeless to the ground.
events.quote: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

events.summary: Harthag laughs at the army before him, mocking them as midgets.
events.quote: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him.

events.summary: A fiery flash and hot flames from Lady Orca leave a man named Angus gone.
events.quote: When I looked again, Angus was gone.

events.summary: Jedit Ojanen leaves his tribe, joins the Robaran Mercenaries and rises to lead them in the battle for Efrava.
events.quote: Jedit Ojanen forsook the forests of his tribe and took service with the Robaran Mercenaries, rising through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.

events.summary: Jacques le Vert abandons his sword and returns to Pendelhaven to protect its creatures.
events.quote: Abandoning his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, Jacques le Vert devoted his life to protecting the creatures of his homeland.

events.summary: Many renowned swordsmen die in Urborg, outmatched by Gwendlyn's wiles.
events.quote: Urborg became the final resting place of many swordsmen of renown, their steel outmatched by the wiles of Gwendlyn.

events.summary: Al-abara lifts one finger and her carpet carries her high out of reach.
events.quote: Al-abara simply laughed and lifted one finger, and the carpet carried her high out of our reach.

events.summary: Nireya reaches through the Planar Gate and senses the energies trapped beyond.
events.quote: Nireya reached through the Gate, sensing the energies trapped beyond.

events.quote: Thundering down from Hammerheim, no foe could slow Bartel's charge.
